message: region `r` is already open: a nested region cannot reuse an enclosing region's name
label: `r` is already the name of an enclosing region
notes: nothing can refer to a region by name yet; when a `@r` in type position can, this is the ambiguity it must not meet
help: rename the inner region: regions are ordered by nesting (MM-RGN-2), and a name that means two extents cannot be ordered
